purpose: Episode 1 (Adults): what the Curiosity Archive is, shown on the real site with one case file.

lines.text: The students who were most sure they would remember <break time="0.4s" /> remembered the least. <break time="0.7s" /> That's a real 2006 experiment, <break time="0.3s" /> and it's the first case file in the Curiosity Archive. <break time="0.5s" /> Here's what it is, in two minutes.
Open dexty dot live and choose Teens and Adults. <break time="0.5s" /> No account, no sign-up. <break time="0.4s" /> The home page shows the latest story, and an editor's pick from the archive.

Every case file starts with one question. <break time="0.5s" /> This one: why does the study method that feels best <break time="0.3s" /> lose to the one that feels worse? <break time="0.6s" /> Then a short story. Three paragraphs, no fluff.

Before the answer, you make a prediction. <break time="0.5s" /> One hundred and eighty students, three ways of studying. <break time="0.3s" /> Which group remembered the most after a week? <break time="0.8s" /> Pick one, <break time="0.4s" /> and you get the real numbers, <break time="0.3s" /> and why your guess was right or wrong. <break time="0.4s" /> No score. Just the reasoning.

Then the evidence dossier. <break time="0.4s" /> Every line is tagged: <break time="0.3s" /> measured, <break time="0.3s" /> interpretation, <break time="0.3s" /> or limit. <break time="0.5s" /> With the page number in the paper. <break time="0.4s" /> So you always know what was shown, what was guessed, and what nobody knows yet.

If it's worth keeping, save it. <break time="0.4s" /> It stays on your device, with the sources. <break time="0.4s" /> And you can write yourself a private takeaway: <break time="0.3s" /> what you'll do differently. <break time="0.4s" /> Nobody else sees it.

That's the Curiosity Archive. <break time="0.4s" /> One surprising question, the story, the evidence, and what it means. <break time="0.5s" /> dexty dot live. <break time="0.5s" /> Did you know that? <break time="0.4s" /> Now you do.
